(e)        Residential streets

All streets, other than those listed in paragraphs (a) through (d) of this Section, that have one or more ground floor dwelling units fronting on the street shall be considered residential streets, except where such street is designated a service street pursuant to paragraph (f) of this Section. (f)        Service streets

All newly constructed streets, other than those listed in paragraphs (a) through (e) of this Section, shall be improved as a service street. A minimum of 50 percent of the uses within stories on the ground floor or with a floor level within five feet of the base plane fronting a service street shall contain non-residential uses.
